title: BuchHaus Microservices
summary: The BuchHaus bookstore split into independent Spring Boot services behind an API gateway, each with its own database.
highlights: Spring Cloud Gateway checks JWTs and routes requests; services find each other through Eureka
Checkout is a saga across two services: reserve stock, save the order, confirm, with compensation if a step fails
OpenFeign calls wrapped in Resilience4j retry and circuit breaker; a CI test stops a service mid-run and checks recovery
55 JUnit tests (H2 and MySQL) and 8 Playwright tests against the full Docker Compose stack

title: DocuMind: RAG Document Q&A
summary: Upload PDFs, ask questions in plain English and get answers grounded in the documents, with page-level citations.
highlights: LangChain ingestion and chunking, OpenAI embeddings stored in Pinecone, answers streamed over server-sent events
Pluggable providers (Claude or OpenAI, Pinecone or in-memory) and an offline mode, so tests run without API keys
Retrieval evaluation (hit rate, MRR, precision@k) used to tune chunking and the similarity threshold
FastAPI back end and Next.js + Tailwind front end; pytest and TypeScript tests, Docker, GitHub Actions

title: BuchHaus: Online Bookstore
summary: A full-stack bookstore: browse and search the catalogue, keep a cart, check out, and manage orders as an admin.
highlights: Spring Security with JWT and customer/admin roles; Flyway migrations on MySQL 8
Row-level locks at checkout, so the last copy of a book can only ever be sold once
41 JUnit tests (unit, Mockito, MockMvc) and 14 Cypress end-to-end tests run against H2, MySQL and the packaged jar

title: Campus Lost & Found
summary: Students post lost and found items with a photo; every new post is matched against the other side by image and text similarity.
highlights: CLIP (ViT-B/32) image and text embeddings with a Pinecone vector index, and an offline embedder for tests
Ownership requests: contact details are shared only after the finder accepts
Precision@k / recall@k / MRR evaluation as a CI quality gate; 35 pytest and 10 Playwright tests; Docker

title: Servisto: Service Marketplace
summary: Book local plumbers, electricians and cleaners: search, pick a time slot, track the booking and review the job.
highlights: Customer and provider roles; bookings move pending → confirmed → completed, enforced on the server
A partial unique index blocks double booking of a slot; taken slots are greyed out in the form
CSRF protection for forms and fetch calls; providers can reply to reviews
55 pytest tests and 6 Playwright browser tests; Docker image tested in GitHub Actions

title: Mandi Price Tracker
summary: Daily crop prices from Maharashtra's APMC markets, imported from the government's open data API, with trends and price alerts.
highlights: Scheduled imports from data.gov.in (Agmarknet), cleaned and stored in MySQL
Trends, market comparisons and seasonality in hand-built SVG charts; watchlist and alerts for signed-in users
67 JUnit tests (including a local server standing in for the API) and 12 Playwright tests

title: Retail Sales SQL Analysis
summary: A MySQL star-schema database for a 12-store retail chain, with 20 business questions answered in SQL and the findings charted.
highlights: CTEs and window functions (RANK, LAG, NTILE, moving averages) for growth, cohorts and RFM segments
Found that 20%+ discounts lose money on electronics and grocery, and that 26% of customers drive 54% of revenue
Every push rebuilds the database and runs all queries on MySQL 8 in GitHub Actions

title: Resume–Job Matcher
summary: A Flask app that scores how well a resume matches a job description and explains what's missing.
highlights: Score combines skill coverage (~100 skills and their spellings) with text similarity from scikit-learn
Lists missing skills, job terms the resume never mentions and what to fix first; safe PDF parsing
21 unit and API tests plus Playwright end-to-end tests on desktop and mobile; Docker image

title: Weather & Air-Quality Dashboard
summary: Live weather, a 5-day forecast and air quality on the Indian AQI scale for any city in India.
highlights: Converts PM2.5 and PM10 to India's AQI using CPCB breakpoints, with the official colour scale
City search with suggestions, geolocation, °C/°F and saved cities; hand-drawn SVG chart
Unit tests with Node's test runner and Playwright tests with the API mocked

title: Placement Prep Tracker
summary: Job applications on a Kanban board, solved DSA problems with a spaced-repetition revision queue, and a progress dashboard.
highlights: SM-2 spaced repetition schedules each problem for revision just before you would forget it
Dashboard with streaks, an activity heatmap and the hiring funnel with conversion rates
68 JUnit tests and 13 Playwright tests, run on H2 and MySQL in GitHub Actions

title: Library Management Database
summary: A MySQL library system where stored procedures handle lending and returns, and triggers keep copy status and fines correct.
highlights: 3NF schema with CHECK, UNIQUE and foreign-key constraints; borrowing rules stored as data
15 months of history (2,200+ loans) replayed through the procedures; views for overdue books and member summaries
15 automated tests run on MySQL 8 in GitHub Actions

title: Smart Expense Splitter
summary: Split group bills equally, by amounts, percentages or shares, and settle up in the fewest possible payments.
highlights: Settlement algorithm checked against brute force on 400 random groups
Balances exact to the paisa; JWT login and group membership checks
60 JUnit tests and 11 Playwright tests, run on H2 and MySQL 8 in GitHub Actions
